# My Point of Truth

Private working preferences for ADHD Support Skills. You approve every entry here. You can view, edit, export or delete any of it at any time.

- Keep this file somewhere private that you choose. Do not put it in a project repository or inside the plugin folder.
- It is plain text and not encrypted.
- Agents may only *propose* additions. Nothing becomes `confirmed` until you approve it.

Do not store diagnoses, health details, crisis history, moods, personality judgements, passwords or other people's private information here.
